data.narrative:
Stoke Space is a Series D-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $860M to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a peer set of 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers, with particular focus on 3 same-stage private companies: Impulse Space ($4.3B), Apex Space ($2.3B), and Varda Space Industries ($1.6B).

Two valuation methods are applicable. The stage-progression approach uses $860M in total raised as a value proxy and applies a 1.5x step-up multiplier typical for Series D advancement, implying $1.3B. The peer-median method anchors to the $2.3B median across the three same-sector, same-stage comparables, with a range spanning $1.6B to $4.3B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to the absence of revenue data, though the sector median P/S multiple across public peers stands at 24.4x.

These two methods produce a triangulated range of $1.1B (low) to $2.6B (high), with a median of $1.8B. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion among private peers ($1.6B–$4.3B spread) and the lack of revenue visibility, which would strengthen valuation confidence through multiple-based anchoring. The $860M raised proxy may understate equity value if substantial secondary transactions or recent investor rounds have not been disclosed.
